## Details

<a id="work_bitmap"></a>
### [`work_bitmap`](../../../../src/data/work_bitmap.asm#L6) `$A530-$A54F`

*variable*

Work bitmap of the fight area: 8 character rows of 320 bytes (bitmap rows 14-21). The fighters are drawn here. The arena change at $8d21 also uses $a530-$b52f as 16 rows of 256 bytes and swaps it with $d000-$dfff.

- **Referred to by:** [`draw_fighter`](../fighter/draw.md#draw_fighter)

<a id="work_strip0"></a>
### [`work_strip0`](../../../../src/data/work_bitmap.asm#L9) `$A550-$A68F`

*variable*

Columns 4-35 of each work bitmap row start at $a550+320k (256 bytes). $8b5b copies them to the screen bitmap.

- **Read by:** [`show_work_bitmap`](../screen/fight_area.md#show_work_bitmap)
- **Written by:** [`restore_work_bitmap`](../screen/fight_area.md#restore_work_bitmap)
